card.name: Journal names in research news
card.fires_on: Words just before a named scientific journal in press-release text, such as "journal", "open access" or "published in". Also digits and hyphens inside BMC journal DOI numbers.

modes.label: Before journal title
modes.description: The word "journal" or "in" right before the name of a journal such as BMC Medicine or PloS One.
modes.example: finds a study in BioMed Central's open access<< journal>> BMC Medicine.

modes.label: Inside DOI numbers
modes.description: Digits or hyphen within a BMC journal DOI string in a citation.

card.plain: It marks the spot in science news where a journal's name is about to be given.
